Mira (CS): Quick ask — need a short zero-touch go-live checklist for Acme (midsize, bursty traffic). Focus: caching/prefill, batching, streaming, telemetry, renewal-risk signals. Will hand to AE + infra. Can we keep it 6-8 action items with owners?

Devon (SWE): Sure. Drafting now — will keep it terse.

Sam - Solutions: pls include a tiny troubleshooting section (cold start signs + quick rollback).

Devon (SWE): 1) Preflight & access (owner: AE) — confirm API keys, VPC peering, KMS access, and test ray of simple requests (10 qps for 2m).

Devon (SWE): 2) Prefill warm pool (owner: CS/SRE) — schedule a prefill covering top 50 prompt sets and target 30-60s warm pool. Use staggered jitter.

Devon (SWE): Example prefill command (one-off):
```
redwood prefill --tenant=acme --model=gptx-8k --prompts-file=top50.txt --pool=warm --concurrency=8 --ttl=3600
```

Alyssa (AE): For midsize customers we usually do TTL=3600 and hit the pool 3x during expected surge window. Good to note.

Devon (SWE): 3) Batching config (owner: SWE/CS) — enable adaptive batching with max_batch_tokens=2048 and latency_slo=200ms for low-p99. Keep per-tenant cap to avoid head-of-line.

Devon (SWE): 4) Streaming & client fallbacks (owner: Solutions) — prefer streaming for UI flows; add knob in client to switch to chunked polling when streams fail. Add a 2s retry with exponential backoff.

Sam - Solutions: 5) Telemetry and alerts (owner: SRE/CS) — instrument: token_cost, p99_latency, active_sessions, queue_depth. Create two alerts: (a) p99 > 500ms for 3m, (b) queue_depth > 75% for 5m. Wire to CS on-call.

Devon (SWE): 6) Renewal-risk signals (owner: CS/AE) — automated flags: 30% sustained usage drop vs baseline (7d), two negative NPSs in 30d, recurring production errors > 0.5% 24h. Tag tenant and trigger outreach.

Alyssa (AE): Can we add a short feedback capture step?

Devon (SWE): 7) Rapid feedback loop (owner: CS/AE) — after go-live send a 48h check-in with: short survey + 3 exemplar prompts for quality evals. Push eval results to a shared doc and set a weekly 1x sync for first 2 weeks.

Sam - Solutions: 8) Troubleshooting quick hits (owner: Solutions/SRE) — signs & quick action: 
- Cold starts: sustained p99 latency spikes, KV misses. Quick fix: re-prefill hot prompts and bump warm pool by 20%.
- Throttling / 429s: check per-tenant rate limits and upstream model fallback. Immediate rollback: switch routing policy to cheaper pre-quantized variant.

onboard-bot: Prefill job scheduled for tenant=\"acme\", job_id=pf-2026-11-30-01 (eta: 18m). :rocket:

Mira (CS): Love it. Short and actionable. I'll paste into the runbook and assign owners. Can someone add the exact alert links and the runbook doc URL when you update?

Alyssa (AE): I'll add the runbook link and the AE checklist items after handoff.

Devon (SWE): I'll follow up with the alert playbook links and a small template for the 48h survey.

Sam - Solutions: Dropping a 2-line snippet for a client-side fallback to include in docs:
```js
// if stream fails, fall back to chunked poll every 1s (max 10 tries)
async function getResponse() {
  try {
    return await startStream();
  } catch(e) {
    return pollChunks({interval:1000, maxTries:10});
  }
}
```

Mira (CS): Perfect — thanks all. I'll close the loop once runbook posted. :thumbsup:
